note: Given atlas and Local (Lemma 13.7, supplied by Use.Offering), Return.grants proves Prereset: the single-exponential identity on flag-free configurations with E^pre the additive sum of the regular activities, and value_income gives positivity at 1 and at U. The weighted bound is funds/4 in place of the named epsilon_m^reg.

lemma grants {E} (hW : Testing.Ringing K g W) (bill : Cosmos Z K W g r E) (hm : m<N)
    (hb : ∀ x∈l,Lives B.bake N (m+1) p (Q x) ∧ (Q x).beta∈band B.a (m+1))
    (ha : ∀ x∈l,atlas B N T d χ r (Q x) X (v x) (τ x)) (hs : ∀ x∈l, Local X (B.a.budget m) (v x) (H x) (w x))
    (he : ∀ x∈l, H x ≤ funds B.a m q / 4) :
    (∀ x∈l, target Q x = earlyValue X (B.kin.path N m) (B.a.params m).clip (B.a.budget m) (v x) (Q x).beta (τ x) (B.kin.alpha N m)) ∧
    Prereset B q l N m p Q τ (fun x => X.read (v x)) := by

structure Prereset (B : Directed G I Z K P) (q : ResetPrices) (s : Set ℝ) (N m p : ℕ) (Q : In B.a m p)
    (u : ℝ → ℝ) (S : ℝ → Activities G (B.a.S.side m p)) : Prop where
  early x : x ∈ s → (S x).EBound (B.a.budget m) (funds B.a m q / 4)
  emit x : x∈s → ∀ V, flags (B.a.budget m).threshold V = ∅ →
    let R := B.kin.path N m; let A := (B.a.params m).clip
    target Q x V = Real.exp (u x * sites (B.a.S.side m p) - ((Q x).beta * mainTerm A R V + B.kin.alpha N m * secondTerm A R V + loop R V) -
      (S x).additive (B.a.budget m) V)

lemma Prereset.value_income (h : Prereset B q s N m p Q u S) (hV : flags (B.a.budget m).threshold V = ∅)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x∈s) :
    (0 < target Q x 1 ∧ 0 < target Q x V) ∧ |scalar (target Q) x - u x| ≤ funds B.a m q / 4 ∧
      |vacuumError B N Q V x| ≤ sites (B.a.S.side m p) * (funds B.a m q / 2) := by
